2608.11924.title: Spark-to-Paper: End-to-End Research Paper Generation as a Composable Skill
2608.11924.paper_summary: Turning a research idea into a complete paper requires more than text generation: the system must retrieve literature, design and execute experiments, revise claims according to evidence, produce publication-ready figures, and maintain consistency across a long generation process. We present Spark-to-Paper, an end-to-end research paper generation system implemented as thirteen composable skills inside an existing coding assistant, without requiring a separate agent platform or orchestration service. Spark-to-Paper separates model-based judgment from deterministic operations that can be directly executed and checked. It further separates experiment planning from reporting, so that required evidence is specified before results are observed and manuscript claims are revised according to measured outcomes. To improve reliability over long research trajectories, the system combines deterministic integrity checks with self-critique and bounds a failure mode we call the Self-Refutation Loop, in which repeated experiments continue to reject the original research objective. Spark-to-Paper also produces editable vector figures through programmatic plotting for experimental results and code-based reconstruction for generated method diagrams. Across eight controlled research topics, Spark-to-Paper achieves 99.5% citation validity and 96.4% figure editability. A controlled ablation increases fabrication detection from 14% for a single-pass draft to 92% with the full integrity and review stack, while adversarial review achieves 74% precision. The full system uses 11.9M tokens, costs $8.1 per manuscript, and requires 3.2 hours on average. These results show that end-to-end research paper generation can be implemented as a lightweight, composable workflow inside existing coding assistants while keeping experimental evidence central to how claims are accepted, revised, or abandoned.
2608.11924.paper_summary_zh: 將研究想法轉化為完整的論文需要的不僅僅是文本生成：系統必須檢索文獻、設計和執行實驗、根據證據修訂主張、生成可發表的圖形，並在長時間的生成過程中保持一致性。<lb/>我們提出了Spark-to-Paper，這是一個端到端的研究論文生成系統，作為現有編碼助手中的十三個可組合技能實現，而無需單獨的代理平台或協調服務。<lb/>Spark-to-Paper將基於模型的判斷與可以直接執行和檢查的確定性操作分開。<lb/>它進一步將實驗計劃與報告分開，以便在觀察結果之前指定所需的證據，並根據測量的結果修訂手稿主張。<lb/>為了提高長期研究過程的可靠性，該系統將確定性完整性檢查與自我批評相結合，並限制一種我們稱之為自我反駁循環的失敗模式，其中重複的實驗持續拒絕原始的研究目標。<lb/>Spark-to-Paper還通過程序化繪圖生成可編輯的向量圖形，以顯示實驗結果，並基於代碼重建生成的方法圖。<lb/>在八個受控的研究主題中，Spark-to-Paper實現了99.5%的引用有效性和96.4%的圖形可編輯性。<lb/>一項受控的消融實驗將單次草稿的製造檢測從14%提高到92%，而完整的完整性和審查堆棧則實現了74%的精確度。<lb/>整個系統使用了11.9M的標記，平均每篇手稿成本為8.1美元，平均需要3.2小時。<lb/>這些結果表明，端到端的研究論文生成可以作為輕量級的可組合工作流程實現在現有的編碼助手中，同時保持實驗證據在主張被接受、修訂或放棄過程中的核心地位。
